{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for commas in revenue
print("Revenue examples:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Remove QA orders
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
# Conversion only applies to completed orders
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()

# Output results
conversion_rates, best_segment"}
